onboarding.title: Welcome to Ravaan (روان)!
onboarding.body:
Welcome to Ravaan!
Key shortcuts:
• Pause: Switch layout (FA ↔ EN)
• Alt+V: Clipboard history
• Shift+Space: Smart half-space
• Alt+L: Show active language
• Ctrl+Alt+S: Quick text statistics
• Ctrl+Shift+Z: Undo autocorrect
